tagline: all things ai (previously peanuts for keypresses)

hero.intro: Hey, I'm Ajax (Thomas). Lifelong programmer; I feel like I've dabbled in almost everything in software. I love meeting people, so you should reach out to catch up about anything. Currently focused on AI and writing my own language and compiler with agents.

projects.name: Alpha
projects.description: An agent-native, dependently typed language and compiler for discovering and executing learning systems. The maths, the learning algorithm, memory layout and machine instructions are one composable program.

projects.name: cdnjs
projects.description: The free CDN for open source JavaScript I co-founded in 2011. On about 11% of all websites, serving 3.3 trillion requests a year.

projects.name: JSON Resume
projects.description: An open standard for resumes as JSON. I co-founded it with Roland Sharp in 2014.

projects.name: Donto
projects.description: A database for claims that might be wrong. Keeps contradictions, ties every claim to its source.

projects.name: Mob Translate
projects.description: Dictionaries and translation for Australian Aboriginal languages.
